messages:
Priya: NovaGen CS flagged their March invoice, they see identical token lines across two pools for the same model window and want a reconciliation + provisional credit.
Ethan: Which invoice/lines? I can pull meter rows.
Priya: INV-2034-NVG line 7 & 8. Customer shows 62,345 tokens on both.
billing-bot: meter extract for INV-2034-NVG:
line,customer,model,pool,tokens
7,nova,redwood-7b,dedicated-west,62345
8,nova,redwood-7b,dedicated-east,62345
Sanjay: Running a join on request_id across pools now. Standby.
Sanjay: Found 12,690 matching request_ids in the window 2026-03-03T10:05:00Z to 2026-03-03T10:12:30Z. Looks like an autoscale+failover overlap where requests were routed then retried to the fallback pool.
Ethan: Do we have unit rate for burst on that invoice?
Priya: Burst unit price on INV-2034-NVG = $5.75 per 1k tokens (invoice metadata).
Ethan: Quick calc: 12,690 tokens = 12.69k tokens * $5.75 = $72.97 -> round to $73.
Priya: Approve provisional credit of $73. Ask accounting to post a pending credit and send a short memo with apology, root cause (autoscale failover double-metering), and ETA for final audit (48h).
Sanjay: I'll attach the matched request_id CSV and raw meter extracts to the thread for the audit. Also opening infra ticket to add guardrails on retry during pool reassignments: https://redwood.internal/ticket/BILL-7689
acct-team: Noted. We'll mark invoice PENDING-CREDIT, apply $73 provisional goodwill credit, and send memo to NovaGen CS. Please confirm if we should pro-rate or refund to payment method.
Priya: Refund to payment method if they request; otherwise credit on next invoice. CS will ask preference.
Ethan: NovaGen replied :thumbsup: and asked for final CSV when audit completes.
notes: Slack thread JSON per agents.md; no title field included.
